 Order

Through the present petition, the petitioner seeks setting aside the impugned order dated 03.05.2025 passed by learned ASJ (SFTC), Dwarka Courts, New Delhi in FIR no. 95/2024 registered at Police Station Dwarka Section 23 for the offences punishable under Sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. Issue notice of the petition as well as the application of condonation of delay i.e., CRL.M.A.
38172/2025 through all permissible modes on filing PF within four weeks.
3.
